Writing a section

A section is one .liqx file. Markup at the top, a <schema> block at the bottom saying what can be edited:

<div class="wrap hero">
  <h1>{section.settings.heading}</h1>
</div>
<schema>
{
  "name": "Hero",
  "settings": [
    { "id": "heading", "type": "text", "label": "Heading", "default": "Hello" }
  ]
}
</schema>

Drop it in sections/, and it appears in the dashboard's Add section list with a text field labelled Heading. There is no registration step.

Values are cast to what their type promises before the template sees them, so {section.settings.padding + 8} is arithmetic, not string concatenation, even though JSON round-tripped it through a form.
